title: Architecture decision records
summary: Record consequential decisions with context, alternatives, consequences and revision history so a reset session can recover the decision and its reason.

provenance.notes: Adds the distinction between an accepted decision and an execution approval: an ADR never authorizes a worker to run.

inputs.name: decision
inputs.description: The decision being taken or reviewed.

inputs.name: existing-adrs
inputs.description: ADRs already in the repository that the decision touches.

outputs.name: adr
outputs.description: A record with id, status, context, decision, alternatives, consequences and source reference.

outputs.name: supersession
outputs.description: Which earlier records it replaces, if any.

workflow.step: Search the repository for existing ADRs covering the same question before writing a new one.
workflow.check: Duplicates are linked or superseded, never contradicted silently.

workflow.step: State the context as forces and constraints that were true at the time, not as a story of the solution.
workflow.check: Someone with no history can see why the decision was needed.

workflow.step: Record the decision in one sentence, then at least two alternatives with the reason each was not chosen.
workflow.check: Alternatives include doing nothing or doing less.

workflow.step: List consequences, both good and bad, and the signal that would make the team revisit the decision.
Set status to proposed until the owner accepts it; link superseded records and keep their text.

constraints: An accepted ADR is a record of intent. It is not an approval for a worker to execute a task.
Never edit an accepted record's decision text; supersede it with a new revision.
Do not record secrets or customer data in an ADR.

examples.title: Replace polling
examples.situation: The team replaces polling with an event stream.
examples.guidance: Create a new ADR marked as superseding the polling decision, keep the old one, and list the migration consequence.

verification: The record has status, context, decision, alternatives, consequences and a source reference.
A superseded record remains readable and points to its replacement.

task.text: Write an ADR with the decision record, alternatives considered and the rationale.
This architecture decision will supersede the old one; update the decision log.
Implement the adr decision record parser.
